context.title: Sunset Merchants Association: positions from signed ballot arguments, 2026-11-03 California general election

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition G (Allowing Private Vehicles on the Great Highway in Sunset Dunes Park)

positions.statement: Sunset Merchants Association signed the rebuttal to the argument in favor of San Francisco Proposition G and the paid argument against San Francisco Proposition G in the San Francisco Voter Information Pamphlet.
